title: pr context and status scope measure the working tree, not the branch
desc:
wb pr context reported changed:[] and size:trivial for a 160-line feature because cli/pr.py:68 measures gitctx.changed_files(root) -- the working tree, already clean after a commit. The same payload builds commits from subjects_since(root, base), so one function answers branch-vs-base for commits and working-tree for files.

Second divergence in the same place: pr.py:66 takes base from flow.source.branch (local main). flow.carry_base(root, source) at flow.py:252 already resolves origin/main when it exists, with a docstring on why a local ref is stale. Nothing in the flow reads a local branch except this.

status.py:271 _scope has the same root cause: after a commit the tree is clean, so wb status reports 'scope -- 0 of 3 planned file(s) changed' for work that is done.

ACCEPTANCE:
- one shared helper in gitctx measures committed-against-base plus working tree, and both callers use it (a second implementation is the divergence this ticket is about)
- pr context on a branch with commits reports the files those commits changed
- pr context resolves its base through flow.carry_base
- status scope counts planned files changed by the branch, committed or not
- a consistency test holds pr context and status to the same answer for one branch
- a branch with no commits above base behaves as it does today
